### Context

Why this change exists. Link the issue if there is one (`Closes #123`).

### What changed

Short bullets by area. Call out anything public: exported API, options, message format, CLI flags, env vars.

### Checklist

- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes
- [ ] README updated for any public surface change
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry under "Unreleased"
- [ ] No breaking change, or the title starts with `feat!:` / `fix!:` and the body explains the migration
